success.description: You invoke the blessing, and all affected characters recover 1 stress, 1 fatigue, and 1 wound.

boon.description: Each enemy within medium range suffers 1 stress.

bane.description: Each character affected by this blessing adjusts his stance one step closer to neutral stance.

reckless.requirements: 7 favour, target engagement within medium range. Effect: Taal empowers your allies in the target engagement. While this blessing is recharging, those characters (whether they remain in the engagement or not) gain a bonus to their DR equal to their depth in their current stance.
